drums.tags: Classical chamber music for solo piano. The piece features a lyrical, rubato-heavy melody in the right hand supported by arpeggiated left-hand accompaniment. The harmonic language is Romantic, utilizing chromatic passing tones and expressive modulations. The dynamic range is wide, shifting from pianissimo delicate passages to forte chordal climaxes. The tempo is fluid, approximately 60 BPM in 4/4 time, with frequent use of ritardando and accelerando. The piano is recorded with a natural, concert hall reverb.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[Solo piano enters, soft arpeggiated left-hand chords]
[Lyrical right-hand melody begins with rubato]

[Section A]
[Melody rises in pitch and intensity]
[Sustained pedal used for resonance]
[Chromatic descending bass line]

[Section B]
[Dynamic increase to forte]
[Dense chordal textures in both hands]
[Rapid arpeggios across multiple octaves]

[Outro]
[Decrescendo to pianissimo]
[Final sustained tonic chord with long decay]

bass.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A Rhodes electric piano plays a jazz-influenced progression with a heavy tremolo effect and high-frequency roll-off. The drum kit features a muffled, low-pass filtered kick drum and a crisp, dry snare with a slight swing. A sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the piano chords. A recurring melodic motif is played on a clean electric guitar with a chorus effect and long reverb tail. Vinyl crackle and static noise are layered throughout the arrangement. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C minor.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and static noise]
[muffled Rhodes electric piano enters with tremolo]

[Main Theme]
[low-pass filtered kick drum and dry snare enter with swung rhythm]
[sub-bass synth enters]
[clean electric guitar with chorus and reverb plays melodic motif]

[Bridge]
[drums drop out]
[Rhodes piano continues with filtered frequency sweep]

[Outro]
[guitar motif fades out]
[drums and bass exit]
[Rhodes piano and vinyl crackle fade to silence]
